verses.text: Ayik yukil ab'ilxo winhaj Joás chi', haxo winhaj sakerdote Joiada ix stek'b'ej sb'a, ix schekan winh awtaj masanil heb' winh yajal soldado, haton heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun kiento heb'. Haton winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Jeroham, winhaj Ismael yuninal winhaj Johanán, winhaj Azarías yuninal winhaj Obed, winhaj Maasías yuninal winhaj Adaías yet' winhaj Elisafat yuninal winhaj Zicri. Ix yalan winh to junxonhej tz'aj spensar heb' winh yet' winh.

Haton heb' winh tik ix b'at t'a masanil yol yik Judá, yik b'at smolb'an masanil heb' winh lewita heb' winh yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun makan yinhtilal Israel, yik skot heb' winh smasanil t'a Jerusalén.

Masanil heb' winh ix smolb'ej sb'a chi', ix sb'o jun strato heb' winh yet' winh rey t'a stemplo Dios. Ix yalan winhaj Joiada chi' t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ina winh yuninalkan winh rey chamnak. Haton winh yowalil tz'och reyal, icha ajnak yak'ankan sti' Jehová yuj heb' yinhtilal winhaj David.
Ha tiknaik jun icha tik ol he k'ulej: Ha ex sakerdote ex tik yet' ex lewita ex tik, a ex ton tzeyil munlajel t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip, ox makan ol ex ajok. Jun makan ex ol he tanhwej sti' stemplo Jehová.
Junxo makan ex ol he tanhwej sti' spalakio winh rey. Ha exxo junxo makan ex, ol ex kan he tanhwej t'a spuertail kimiento. Haxo masanil anima, wach' skannhej heb' t'a yol yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová tik.

Palta malaj junok mach syal yoch t'a yol templo chi', anhej heb' winh sakerdote yet' heb' winh lewita ayoch t'a yopisio syal yochi, yujto sik'b'ilel heb' winh. Haxo masanil anima, skan heb' t'a yamaq'uil templo chi', icha yalan scheknab'il Jehová.

Ha exxo lewita ex tik, ol ex och hoyan t'a spatik winh rey, junjun ex eyet'nakokab' eyamk'ab' yik owal. Ha mach syak' pural yekanoch sb'a t'a yol templo chi', b'enhej schami. Ha exxo tik, ajun exnhej yet' winh rey chi' yalnhej b'aj sb'at winh, xchi winhaj Joiada chi'.

Ha heb' winh lewita chi' yet' masanil heb' anima aj Judá chi', ix sk'anab'ajej heb' masanil tas ix yal winhaj sakerdote Joiada chi'. Junjun heb' winh yajal soldado chi', ayek' heb' winh yet' heb' ayoch t'a yalanh smandar heb' winh, haton heb' smunlaj t'a yopisio t'a sk'ual ik'oj ip yet' heb' tz'elkani, yujto maj chajiel-laj heb' yuj winhaj Joiada chi' ayik sk'och yorail yel heb'.
Ix yak'anpax k'een lanza winhaj Joiada chi' yet' maklab' jul-lab' t'a heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun kiento heb' soldado chi', haton juntzanh syamk'ab' winhaj rey David aykan t'a stemplo Dios.

Ix ak'chajoch masanil heb' winh winak chi' yuj winh t'a stzolal, junjun heb' winh yet'nak syamk'ab' yik owal, yik stanhwan winh rey chi' heb' winh. Ix och hoyan heb' winh t'a schanh pak'anhil yamaq'uil stemplo Jehová chi' yet' b'aj ay jun altar yet' t'a spuertail templo chi'.

Ixlajwi chi', a winhaj sakerdote Joiada chi' yet' heb' yuninal ix ik'anelta winh yuninalkan winh rey chi'. Ix yak'ank'e skorona winh heb', ix yak'an jun yumal strato Dios heb' t'a winh. Ixlajwi chi', ix yak'ank'e akeite heb' t'a sjolom winh, ix yalan heb' to reyxo winh. Ix k'e nhilnaj masanil anima yalani: Niwanokab' yelk'och winh ko rey, xchi heb'.
Ayik ix yab'an ix Atalía chi' yel yaw heb' anima chi' yeq'ui, syak'an b'inaj winh rey chi' heb', ix b'at ix t'a stemplo Jehová chi'.

Haxo ix yilan ix, a winh rey chi' linhanoch winh t'a jun niwan yoyal sti' stemplo Jehová chi', haxo t'a stz'ey winh ayek' heb' winh yajal yaji yet' heb' winh spu'an k'een trompeta. Masanil heb' anima chi' stzalaj heb'. Ay heb' spu'an k'een strompeta, ay pax heb' sb'itan yet' syamk'ab', haton heb' skuchb'an b'it chi' yik syalan wach' lolonel heb' t'a Dios. Yuj chi', ix stzilchitanb'at spichul ix, ix yalan ix icha tik: --Pechum ex el yajal a ex tik. Pechum ex el yajal, xchi ix.

Palta a winhaj Joiada chi' ix chekan elta heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun kiento heb' soldado, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ik'ekel ix b'aj tzolan ex och chi'. Yalnhej mach syak'och sb'a yet' ix, tze xikchamok, xchi winh. Toxo ix yal winhaj Joiada chi' to manhok t'a stemplo Jehová smiljicham ix.
Ix syaman ix heb' winh, ix yik'anel ix heb' winh t'a spuertail yik nok' schej winh rey, hata' ix miljicham ix yuj heb' winh.
Ixlajwi chi' ix sb'oan jun trato winhaj sakerdote Joiada chi' yet' masanil heb' anima chi' yet' winh rey chi', ix yalan heb' to ol ochkan heb' schonhab'ok Jehová.

Elanhchamel ix b'at heb' t'a stemplo Baal, ix b'at spojanem heb', ix smak'anpaxpoj altar heb' yet' juntzanh yechel komon Dios. Haxo winhaj Matán sakerdote yik Baal chi', ha t'a yichanh altar chi' ix smilcham winh heb'.

Ix yak'ankan juntzanh munlajel t'a stemplo Jehová chi' winhaj Joiada chi' t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh sakerdote yet' heb' winh lewita, yik wach' sk'anab'ajej heb' winh sb'oan munlajel ak'b'ilkan t'a yol sk'ab' heb' winh yuj winhaj rey David. Haton yik snhusji silab' tz'ak'ji t'a Jehová icha yalan ley tz'ib'ab'ilkan yuj winhaj Moisés. Ay pax heb' sb'itan t'a tzalajk'olal icha yutejnakkan winhaj rey David chi'.
Ix yak'anpaxoch heb' stanhwan sti' stemplo Jehová chi' winh, yik wach' max och heb' anima manh wach'ok yaj icha yalan ley.

Ix yawtankot masanil heb' winh yajalil heb' soldado winhaj Joiada chi' yet' heb' winh niwak yelk'ochi yet' heb' winh yajal yaj t'a junjun chonhab' yet' pax masanil anima chi'. Ix yik'anelta winh rey chi' heb' t'a stemplo Jehová, ix yik'anb'at winh heb' t'a spalakio heb' rey. Ix och heb' t'a jun puerta t'a yib'anh. Ix yak'ankanem k'ojan winh heb' t'a sk'ojnub' heb' winh rey chi'.
Masanil heb' anima, ix te tzalajk'e heb', yujto toxo ix xikjicham ix Atalía. Yuj chi' junk'olal ix ajkan jun chonhab' chi'.
